baseline.description: shared helper rows (stance states, helper skills, stats) used by several Sorceress skills

r0_single.description: R0 control: one diagnostic state per stance (group 13 = mutually exclusive), exaggerated visible stats

r1_leapchain.description: R1: separate BENEFIT states (no group) and PENALTY states (group 14, exclusive), for the leap-chain test

r2_func18.description: R2: helper skills use srvdofunc 18 (armor-type, known to apply aurastat lists); R1 showed func 23 applied the state/visuals but no stats

r3_chain_missile.description: R3: one cast = chain (calc5) applies PENALTY + srvmissilea self-hit pulse applies BENEFIT; two exclusive-group penalties (group 14), benefits ungrouped

r4_roles.description: R4: r3 states/helpers plus a penalty pulse missile; used to find out whether the missile route or the benefit helper was the problem

r5_targetstate.description: R5: like r3, but the pulse-cast benefit helpers use auratargetstate + range + player filter (how Battle Trance Pulse works), not aurastate

r6_diag.description: R6 diagnostic: pulse missiles made VISIBLE; helpers carry both aurastate and auratargetstate (range 15, player filter)

r7_single_echo.description: R7: one combined boon/bust state per stance, mutually exclusive (group 13); Echo carries a share of the other stances' boons

r8_real_stances.description: R8: real first-pass stat stances (mastery/FCR/FRW/FHR/dodge boons, resist busts), persistent floor overlays, slow S1 cast animation

r9_anim.description: R9: fire floor overlay = holy-fire back ring; animation experiments (SOSC 128, SOS1 64); no cooldown

r10_frames.description: R10: fire overlay front+back rings; animation experiments by frame count (SC 28, S1 40, events scaled) + SQ sequence states for Overcharge

r11_sequences.description: R11: all three stances use SQ sequence state-machine steps with different clip chains; animdata stretching removed

r12_clips.description: R12: single-step sequences to identify clips and test loop counts (fire skill1 x2, cold skill2, lightning skill4)

r13_seqnum.description: R13: all three loop their clip twice; seqnum varied (4 / 6 / 13) to see whether the effect timing moves

anim_v1.description: anim_v1: stance cast animations locked in (Fire skill1 x3, Cold skill2 x3, Lightning cast x2; seqnum 4/6/13)

anim_v2.description: anim_v2: every stance uses the Cryostasis cast (skill2 x3, hands held in front); seqnum 4/6/13 unchanged

anim_v3.description: anim_v3: every stance holds skill2 x6 (FCR from Fire stance shortens casts, including switching away from it)

anim_v3_cltevent.description: anim_v3 + client event on the Fire stance state (cltevent domissiledamage, clteventfunc 1), as the chillingarmor state has

p4d_events.description: P4d event probes: Fire=doactive, Cold=domissileattack, Lightning=hitbymissile (vanilla-proven); state cltevent matches each

p4e_hex_style.description: P4e: Fire stance applies a burst-overlay debuff state (hex-style: func 36 on domissiledamage -> auratargetstate) to every monster our missiles hit
